title: 第12章 双重身份第13章 神兵宗与冰风谷
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
冷幽兰整理了一下自己的衣裙，然后穿上了她那件红色的铠甲。想起昨晚她穿得这么少，和沉翔一起睡的时候，她微微低着头，整张脸都红了；她不敢看沉翔。
沉翔本来以为冰风谷的掌教和丹香桃园的掌教一样神秘，但没想到，冰风谷的掌教却是神秘莫测。她永远不会出现在公共场合。然而出乎他的意料，院长竟然亲自来到了这里，这让他和冷幽兰都有些惊讶。
“你们院长到底为什么来这里？”
沉翔跟着冷幽兰离开了房间。此时，他忽然感觉有些寒冷，因为院长不断的释放出一股压迫性的寒气；这些有权有势的人物就喜欢这样行事，这不仅是一种炫耀，还会吓到别人，更何况还能起到震慑作用。
穿过几道通道，沉翔等人来到了一座大厅。丹渊和另外两名真武境弟子也都在这里。他们的身体都在微微颤抖。这座大厅的墙壁已经完全被冰霜覆盖，主座上坐着一个穿着黑色长袍、脸上覆盖着白色纱布的女子。虽然她穿着长袍，但依然掩盖不了她曼妙的身材。
这个女子，正是冰风谷的掌教！
看到院长，沉翔更加确定，这个院长和丹长老一样，肯定有什么不能让别人知道的秘密，否则，他们不会连眼睛都被白光遮住。
虽然看不到院长的眼睛，但沉翔可以肯定，院长正在盯着他看，这让他感到害怕。
“你就是沉翔？不错啊！”
院长的声音没有任何感情，冰冷如冰。任谁听到都会感到彻底的害怕。如果院长在晚上出现，哪怕她不释放那股压迫性的寒气，也能吓死人。
丹渊等人都站着，不敢坐。冰风谷的院长突然出现，他们连做梦都没有想到这一点。不过，这也让他们放心了，他们估计，冰风谷的掌教肯定会出手，插手此事。
沉翔正要行礼，却突然听到龙雪怡惊呼道：“这不是梦儿姐姐吗？一定是她，我没有看错！不信你就摸摸她吧。”她身上融合了朱雀柔线，那就是你觉醒的朱雀神兵，肯定和你还有着某种联系！”
沉翔吓呆了，冰风谷的掌教，竟然是神兵天帝国的女帝！皇后不是用火吗？可是，冰风谷的掌教，竟然拥有如此强大的冰寒真气！
“这么说来，她知道你可能会认出她，所以才故意释放寒气，以免你感应到朱雀嫩丝！”
苏媚瑶也是惊讶极了。
“看来这个女人和你姐姐一样，都拥有冰火天脉，而且从她所释放的寒气来看，她至少也拥有冰火天脉！”
白幽幽说道。
当年冷幽兰前往太武宗的时候，正是丹长老将冷幽兰交给了冰风谷掌教；由此可见，两人的关系相当不错！
“她是神兵天帝国的女帝，同时也是神秘的冰风谷院长，这个女人了不起！”
苏媚瑶惊呼道。

沉翔的心境，虽如大海汹涌，但神色却依然没有任何变化，客气道：“沉翔小子，见过院长！”
“不必太过客气！”
院长冷声说道，见她如此装腔作势，沉翔心中暗自好笑。他很想看看，当他揭穿她的时候，她会是什么表情？
这时，院长站了起来，来到了沉翔的面前，冷冷的问道：“你身上怎么有这么多的气味？这是幽兰的，你们昨晚是在一起的吗？”
沉翔和冷幽兰顿时石化了；丹渊等人不禁一愣，但很快又释然了。冷幽兰和沉翔是绝配，沉翔虽然表面上收了她为结拜姐妹，但这种手段却是相当常见，让所有人的思绪都不由飘零。
冷幽兰彻底尴尬了，脸上的红晕已经到了耳边，现在的她已经没有了之前的霸道气势；她真的表现得像个女孩。
沉翔知道院长是柳梦儿，所以他现在显得异常平静。他微微一笑，说道：“昨晚，我和她睡在一起，我们好多年没见面了，一边聊天一边睡着了，我们是兄妹，没问题的！”
content_en:
Leng Youlan adjusted her clothes and then put on her red armor. Thinking of how little she wore last night and when she slept with Chen Xiang, she lowered her head slightly and her whole face turned red; she didn't dare to look at Chen Xiang.
Chen Xiang originally thought that the headmaster of Icewind Valley was as mysterious as the headmaster of Danxiang Taoyuan, but he did not expect that the headmaster of Icewind Valley was mysterious. She would never be seen in public. However, to his surprise, the dean came here in person, which surprised both him and Leng Youlan.
"Why on earth is your dean here?"
Chen Xiang followed Leng Youlan and left the room. At this time, he suddenly felt a little cold, because the dean continued to release an oppressive cold air; these powerful people like to act like this. It is not only a way of showing off, but also scares others, not to mention it can also act as a deterrent.
After passing through several passages, Chen Xiang and others arrived at a hall. Dan Yuan and two other Zhenwu Realm disciples are also here. Their bodies were shaking slightly. The walls of this hall were completely covered with frost, and sitting on the main seat was a woman wearing a black robe and her face covered with white gauze. Although she was wearing a robe, it still couldn't hide her graceful figure.
This woman is the headmaster of Icewind Valley!
Seeing the dean, Chen Xiang was even more sure that this dean, like Elder Dan, must have some secrets that cannot be known to others, otherwise, their eyes would not be covered by the white light.
Although he couldn't see the dean's eyes, Chen Xiang was sure that the dean was staring at him, which made him feel scared.
"Are you Chen Xiang? Not bad!"
The dean's voice was emotionless and as cold as ice. Anyone who hears it would be utterly terrified. If the dean appears at night, even if she doesn't release the oppressive cold air, it will scare people to death.
Dan Yuan and others were standing and did not dare to sit down. The Headmaster of Icewind Dale suddenly appeared, something they never even dreamed of. However, this also reassured them. They estimated that the headmaster of Icewind Valley would definitely take action and intervene in this matter.
Chen Xiang was about to salute when he suddenly heard Long Xueyi exclaim: "Isn't this Sister Meng'er? It must be her, I saw it right! If you don't believe me, just touch her." Her body is fused with the Suzaku Soft Thread, which is the Suzaku Divine Weapon you awakened. She must have some connection with you! "
Chen Xiang was stunned. The headmaster of Icewind Valley was actually the empress of the Divine Weapon Empire! Doesn’t the queen use fire? However, the headmaster of Icewind Valley actually possesses such powerful ice cold energy!
"So, she knew that you might recognize her, so she deliberately released the cold air to prevent you from sensing the tender silk of Suzaku! "
Su Meiyao was also extremely surprised.
"It seems that this woman, like your sister, has the Ice and Fire Heavenly Vein, and judging from the cold energy she releases, she at least also has the Ice and Fire Heavenly Vein! "
Bai Youyou said.
When Leng Youlan went to Taiwuzong, it was Elder Dan who handed Leng Youlan over to the headmaster of Icewind Valley; this shows that the relationship between the two is quite good!
"She is the empress of the Divine Weapon Empire, and she is also the mysterious Dean of Icewind Valley. This woman is amazing! "
Su Meiyao exclaimed.
Although Chen Xiang's state of mind was as turbulent as the sea, his expression remained unchanged and he said politely: "Young man Chen Xiang, I have met the dean! "
"Don't be too polite! "
The dean said coldly. Seeing her putting on airs like this, Chen Xiang was secretly amused. He wanted to see what her expression would be like when he exposed her?
At this time, the dean stood up, came to Chen Xiang, and asked coldly: "Why do you have so much smell on your body? This is Youlan's. Were you together last night? "
Chen Xiang and Leng Youlan were immediately petrified; Dan Yuan and others were stunned, but soon felt relieved. Leng Youlan and Chen Xiang are a perfect match. Although Chen Xiang ostensibly accepts her as a sworn sister,This method is quite common and makes everyone's thoughts wander.
Leng Youlan was completely embarrassed. The blush on her face had reached her ears. Now she no longer had the domineering aura she had before; she really acted like a girl.
Chen Xiang knew that the dean was Liu Menger, so he seemed extremely calm now. He smiled slightly and said: "Last night, she and I slept together. We hadn't seen each other for many years. We fell asleep while chatting. We are brothers and sisters, no problem!"
